title: Cheesy Garlic Bread
description: 1 French bread loaf with garlic butter and mozzarella. Serves 2 to 4.
steps: Preheat oven on Air Fry mode to 375°F.
Mix butter, wet garlic, garlic powder, salt, and parmesan.
Cut the loaf in half lengthwise (and in half across if it's long). Spread the butter mix to the edges.
Place cut side up on a foil-lined sheet pan. Bake 4 min to toast the butter in.
Top with mozzarella. Bake 4 to 6 min more, until the cheese is melted with golden spots and the edges are crisp. Watch it closely, this mode browns fast.
source: Joe's Meal Pack, Oct 20 to Nov 4, 2026 (built by Thrifty, now kept by Meal Plan), R10
notes: 15 min. Leftovers: wrap in foil, fridge (3 days; freezer 1 month in foil). Reheat in the oven at 350°F in foil 8 min, then open the foil 2 to 3 min to re-crisp. Microwave makes it chewy.

healthy: Mozzarella gives some protein and calcium.
not_healthy: French bread is refined white flour.
6 Tbsp butter and cheese add saturated fat.
Bread, cheese and salt add sodium.
